title: Writing --- My Own Line
label: ch:fr-ma-propre-ligne
canDo: I can write one line about myself from a closed supply of known words, with nothing to copy, and put every accent on.

payoff.summary: Complete FR-W02-ma-propre-ligne: subject, verb and the rest, chosen rather than copied, with the accents checked before anything else.
payoff.note: The first writing step with nothing to reach for. The French-specific check arrives with it: an accent is part of the letter, not a flourish on it, and a hand that omits one has written a different word.
